segments.text: You hear a dietician talking with a patient.
So it looks like you haven't lost any weight this month
Do you have any idea why that might be?
I feel like I've been trying really hard to lose weight
In fact, I thought I would take it a step further in the past couple of weeks
Because I was a bit bad in the first week or so
So recently I've been trying to cut out all carbs and any junk food
And, you know, to be completely honest, though, I've wound up cheating on my diet.
Well, you need to stop being so strict with yourself.
We designed your diet so that it would be achievable.
When you try and do things too quickly and make too many changes to what your body is used to,
it's difficult to maintain long term, and you end up overeating as a result.
Also, I can't imagine that it made you feel good about your progress when you kept going off track.
I guess I need to be kinder to myself and be more patient with the slow and steady route.
